captions.detailed: A dual-panel panoramic sunroof cassette with a wide front glass panel and a rear glass panel, both on prismatic slides. The entire assembly is housed in a sleek, rectangular black outer frame. The front panel slides prismatically rearward under the rear panel, while the rear panel can also slide independently rearward into the roof cavity. Both panels feature dark tinted glass with elegant, thin longitudinal accent lines.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated dual-panel panoramic sunroof cassette with a black outer frame and two glass panels. The front panel and rear panel should both be connected to the frame via prismatic joints, allowing them to slide independently along the longitudinal axis.
captions.factory: Construct a rectangular outer frame by subtracting an inner box from a larger box, and add side tracks using boolean operations. Model the front and rear glass panels as flat rectangular boxes with thin decorative grooves. Define the frame as the base link, and attach both the front and rear glass panels using prismatic joints aligned along the X-axis with appropriate motion limits.
